text: We are looking for: 🚦 We’re Hiring: Transport Planners 📍 Gurgaon | 🏢 Surbana Jurong India | 💼 Full-Time About the Role We’re looking for Transport Planners to join our growing team. In this role, you’ll work on a variety of impactful projects, from strategic transport planning to data-driven modelling and infrastructure design. You’ll collaborate with engineers, policymakers, and stakeholders to deliver innovative solutions that improve mobility for communities. What You’ll Do 🔹 Lead transport planning projects from inception to delivery 🔹 Develop transport strategies, studies, and assessments 🔹 Direct primary and secondary data collection 🔹 Analyse traffic patterns and model scenarios for urban and regional transport networks 🔹 Prepare high-quality technical reports and presentations 🔹 Contribute to planning applications and transport statements 🔹 Work closely with clients, local authorities, and project partners 🔹 Support the delivery of sustainable and future-focused mobility solutions What We’re Looking For ✔ Postgraduate Degree in Transport Planning, ✔ 2-4 years of relevant work experience in transport planning or traffic engineering ✔ Experience with transport modelling tools (e.g., VISSIM, VISUM, CUBE) and GIS ✔ Strong analytical skills and attention to detail ✔ Clear, confident communication—written and verbal ✔ Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team Why Join Us? 🌱 Work on meaningful, community-focused projects 🤝 Collaborative, supportive team culture 📈 Professional development and career progression At Surbana Jurong, we put talent, hard work, teamwork and a fun workplace together to approach problems and solve them creatively and collaboratively. Join us in making a positive impact on the world!
